newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Bank upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Bank upgraded.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp analyst James Schutz said he upgraded First Bank System Inc to a buy from a hold as a result of its planned acquistion of U.S. Bancorp.
-- "We believe this transaction will be accretive to 1998 earnings per share to the tune of about $0.15," Schutz said in a report made Thursday, but received Friday morning.
-- The analyst said he raised his 1998 earnings estimate to $6.20 from $6.05 but cut his 1997 estimate to $5.20 from $5.35.

-- "We are slightly more aggressive on 1998 accretion than the company's forecasts because we believe U.S. Bancorp's markets could generate significantly more growth than First Bank's current markets.
-- On Thursday, First Bank announced plans to acquire U.S. Bancorp in a nearly $9.0 billion deal.
-- First Bank shares were up 1-3/4 at 77-1/4 on Friday. U.S. Bancorp shares were up 1-5/8 at 56-3/4.
